usbHint: Scan the next parcel with the USB scanner and it opens on this page.
invalidQrTitle: This QR code is not valid for scanning
invalidQrText: Scan the QR code on the label again.
waitForAction: Wait for the action to finish, then scan the next parcel.

order.title: Order №{{id}}
order.alertText: Details of the order found by QR
order.notFoundText: No order data was returned for this QR code, or the order may have been removed.

courier.title: Take the order
courier.text: The order will be assigned to you. The scanner then opens again — scan the next parcel.
courier.assignSuccess: The order is assigned to you

manager.title: Actions
manager.text: If the customer is at the branch — sell it. If it needs home delivery — assign it to a courier.
manager.rulesHint: Sell and cancel are shown if you have the permission and the order is not with a courier.
manager.noPermission: The admin grants the sell and cancel permission. Without it only assigning remains.
manager.courierHeldNoName: The order is with a courier
manager.courierHeldText: The order is with a courier — the courier sells or cancels it.
manager.dispatchSub: The order is added to the assignment list

package.title: Package {{code}}
package.alertText: Package details and the orders inside
package.ordersEmpty: No orders found inside this package
package.actionText: The package and its orders are received into your branch. The scanner then opens again.
package.alreadyReceived: This package has already been received
package.wrongBranch: You cannot receive this package — it belongs to another branch
package.notFoundText: No package data was returned for this QR code, or the package may already be closed.

post.title: Post №{{id}}
post.alertText: Go back to the scanner to read another code
post.ordersEmpty: No orders found in this post
post.actionText: Open the post page to receive its orders and see their status.
post.notFoundText: No post data was returned for this QR code, or it may have already been closed.

scanner.title: QR scanner
scanner.subtitle: Scan an order, package or mail QR code — the right page opens by itself
scanner.usbText: Scan a code — it works together with the camera. It doesn't matter where the cursor is.
scanner.manualHint: If the QR is damaged, type the code from the label
scanner.manualDialogHint: Type the code under the QR or the scanner link

tips.light: Make sure there is enough light
tips.center: Keep the code near the centre of the frame

scanner.recentEmptyText: The camera is waiting for a QR code. The result appears here as soon as a code is found.
scanner.phoneEmptyText: The right page opens as soon as a code is found
scanner.previousOpening: The previous code is still opening — this scan was not accepted. Scan again.

invalid.title: This QR code is not valid for the scanner
invalid.text: This is not an Elchi code — probably a shop or manufacturer label. Scan the QR code on the Elchi label.

marketQr.title: This is a shop QR code
marketQr.text: It is used to hand cancelled orders back to the shop — scan it on the Cancelled page.

error.title: Couldn't check the code
error.text: Check the internet connection and scan the code again.

marketBlocked.title: The scanner is not for the shop role
marketBlocked.text: Follow your orders in the Orders section.

bag.title: Bag of external parcels
bag.alertText: List of parcels in the bag
bag.membersEmpty: No parcels found in the bag
bag.actionText: Parcels are received on the Incoming parcels page: choose the source and scan the bag label — every parcel in the bag gets marked.
